name: כַּפְתֹּרִים
summary: The Caphtorim, a people Genesis counts among the descendants of Mizraim, who came from Caphtor. The gentilic is formed from the place name Caphtor.

evidence.note: The final וְאֶת introduces the Caphtorim as the last people in the list governed by יָלַד, with Mizraim as its subject.
The phrase כַּפְתֹּרִים הַיֹּצְאִים מִכַּפְתּוֹר identifies the people by the place from which they came.

note: Moved from the former word entry `kkapettoriym`. כפתר recorded the consonantal stem of the gentilic.
